handoff: Approve: AC1-AC4 met with S1 tests; integration checks, unit tier, typecheck green. 3 minor + 1 nit (displaced JSDoc in format.ts, plain status markdown lacks round, duplicated totals fold, rows without a round heading dropped). AC5 left to QA.

findings.title: formatStepTimeline's doc comment now sits on roundEndText
findings.detail:
The new roundEndText function and its JSDoc were inserted between formatStepTimeline's existing doc block ('entered, left, duration, outcome, who …') and the function, so two JSDoc blocks now stack on roundEndText and formatStepTimeline has none.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Move roundEndText above the existing doc block.

findings.title: The plain `norn status` markdown does not show the round
findings.detail:
B28 says 'norn status … show the round number and its workflow'. AC2 and the Plan coverage row only require `status --json`, which this change meets; the markdown inbox is unchanged (the handoff says so on purpose). A person reading plain `status` still does not see the round.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Consider a follow-up that adds 'round N · <wf>' to the markdown item line, if the person wants B28 met in full.

findings.title: storyTimeline's single-round branch ignores the event window and the totals fold
findings.detail:
With one round (or a flat record), build(current) is used as is. That is correct today. But the multi-round branch rebuilds the totals by hand (by_type, by_step, human_wait_ms, wall_clock_ms). This copies part of buildStepTimeline's aggregation, so a new field in StepTotals would be silently taken from the last round only.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optional: fold totals with a helper beside mergeStoryTimeline in steps.ts so both merges share it.

findings.title: Rows whose round has no heading are dropped from the text silently
findings.detail:
When v.rounds is set, only rows whose round matches a RoundView are printed. A slice row whose state.round names a round with no folder (e.g. a corrupt round folder that storyRounds skips for lacking state.json) would vanish from the text but stay in --json.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Print any leftover rows after the last heading.
